Agitator Agitator — Tier 1: Pamphleteer
Alchemist’s  There is no current official Career for an Alchemist, however, you can have a similar Character
by taking the Apothecary — Tier 1: Apothecary's Apprentice Career, and changing Trade
Apprentice
(Apothecary) to Trade (Alchemist).

WFRP1 are not covered in WFRP4. However, you can have a similar Character by taking
Druid

Apprentice Career, and focusing on Jade magic.
